_comment: Translatable strings for product assessments. Copy en.json, translate values only, keep every {placeholder} intact.

additiveBasis.eu_not_authorised: no longer authorised as a food additive in the EU
additiveBasis.eu_child_attention_warning: EU law requires a warning that it may affect activity and attention in children
additiveBasis.iarc_2a: linked by IARC to a group 2A classification for ingested nitrate/nitrite under conditions leading to nitrosation
additiveBasis.efsa_group_adi: covered by an EFSA acceptable daily intake
additiveBasis.efsa_adi_lowered: subject to an EFSA intake limit that was revised downwards
additiveBasis.mandatory_allergen_labelling: must be declared as an allergen above 10 mg/kg

blocker.allergen_declared.label: Declared allergen
blocker.allergen_declared.evidence: The package data explicitly declares {allergen}, which is on your allergen list.

blocker.allergen_ingredient.label: Allergen found in ingredients
blocker.allergen_ingredient.evidence: "{match}" appears in the ingredient list and matches your {allergen} allergen.

blocker.diet_conflict.label: Conflicts with your diet
blocker.diet_conflict.evidence: Ingredient analysis marks this product as incompatible with {diet} ({evidence}).

warning.allergen_traces.label: May contain traces
warning.allergen_traces.evidence: The package declares possible traces of {allergen}. This is a manufacturer warning, not an ingredient.

warning.diet_uncertain.label: Diet status unclear
warning.diet_uncertain.evidence: Some ingredients cannot be confirmed as {diet}. Check the package before buying.

warning.allergen_data_missing.label: Allergen data is incomplete
warning.allergen_data_missing.evidence: No allergen declaration is available for this product, so your allergen list could not be checked. An empty list never proves the product is free from it.

base.nutriscore.label: Nutri-Score {grade}
base.nutriscore.evidence: Open Food Facts publishes Nutri-Score {grade} for this product; it sets the baseline nutritional quality before your goals are applied.

base.nutrition_profile.label: Nutritional profile
base.nutrition_profile.evidence: No Nutri-Score is published, so the baseline is derived from the declared values: {detail}.

base.nutrition_unknown.label: Baseline quality unknown
base.nutrition_unknown.evidence: Not enough nutrition data is available to judge baseline quality, so the score starts from a neutral midpoint.

base.nova.label: {novaLabel}
base.nova.evidence: Open Food Facts classifies this product in NOVA group {group}.

base.additive_high.label: Additive of concern
base.additive_high.evidence: {names}: {basis}. IngreFit rates this as high-attention, so the product cannot reach a high baseline score.

base.additive_moderate.label: Additives to be aware of
base.additive_moderate.evidence: {count} additive(s) with a defined intake limit or classification: {names}.

base.additives_clean.label: No flagged additives
base.additives_clean.evidence: The declared additive list contains nothing that IngreFit flags for extra attention.

base.fruit_veg.label: Fruit, vegetable and nut content
base.fruit_veg.evidence: Open Food Facts estimates {percent}% fruit, vegetable, pulse and nut content from the ingredient list.

base.palm_oil.label: Contains palm oil
base.palm_oil.evidence: Ingredient analysis detects palm oil, which raises the saturated fat load and carries known sourcing concerns.

base.organic.label: Certified organic
base.organic.evidence: The product carries an official organic label. IngreFit records this but gives it only a small weight, because organic status does not by itself improve nutritional quality.

base.alcohol.label: Contains alcohol
base.alcohol.evidence: The product declares {percent}% alcohol by volume.

label.bad: High saturated fat for your goal

personal.processing.evidence: NOVA group {group} is weighed against your "{goal}" goal.

personal.no_data.label: Not enough data for your goals
personal.no_data.evidence: None of the values needed for your selected goals are available, so the score reflects general product quality only.

summary.blocked: This product is ruled out by a hard restriction in your profile: {blocker}. Quality is secondary here, the restriction stands regardless of the other numbers.
summary.withSignals: Baseline product quality is {base} out of 10, and {personal}. The strongest influences were {strongest}. This measures fit with your profile, not universal healthiness.
summary.withoutSignals: Baseline product quality is {base} out of 10, and {personal}. There is not enough data for a finer breakdown.

dataNotice.aiPhoto: Source: AI visual identification. Nutrition is an approximate estimate from appearance; ingredients, allergens and exact values remain unknown. Score confidence: {confidence}%.
dataNotice.estimatedText: Fact source: {source}. Missing values were estimated by AI from the name and ingredients, not read from the package. Score confidence: {confidence}%.

tip.blocked: Always check the package before buying: recipes change without the database being updated.
tip.highRiskAdditive: To avoid {code}, look for the same kind of product with a shorter ingredient list.
tip.ultraProcessed: This is an ultra-processed product. A less processed equivalent usually scores noticeably higher at baseline.
tip.default: The score is tied to your profile ({diet}). Change your goals and the result is recalculated.
